name: Laid-back
description: Easy-going and food-first; training can always wait until after a nap and a big meal.

bye: See ya... I'm gonna nap now.
ask: Hey {player}... could you maybe get me {need}? I'm too comfy to move, {catch}.
cold: ...I'm pretending to be asleep. Go away.
small: One senzu bean fills you up for ten days. What a waste of a good appetite, {catch}.
I once ate a whole Saiyan-sized dinner. No regrets.
Training? Nah... maybe tomorrow. The beach at Kame House is calling.
friend: {player}! You're my favourite person. After food. Maybe tied.
greet: Oh, hey {player}... I was just about to have a snack.
Mmm... hi. You woke me up, {catch}.
love: Whoa... this is the best day of my life, {player}. {catch}!
beaten: Okay, you're beat... can we stop now?
captive_freed: Free... gonna nap somewhere safe now.
chat_tense_reply: Some of us actually enjoy life, {target}.
compliment: You always know the best snack spots, {target}.
confide: You ever think about leaving all this, {target}? Just... napping forever?
I trust you, {target}. More than most.
faction_found: So... this is {faction} now. Anyone can join, I guess.
Yeah, this is {faction}. Come hang out.
faction_tier: Huh... we're a {tier} now. {faction} is going places. Cool.
faction_vassal: {faction}'ll stand under {overlord}. {leader} earned it... less work for me.
faction_welcome_player: Welcome, {player}... we look after our own.
Hey {player}, welcome. Make yourself at home.
fall: Nah... I'm done getting stepped on. Done.
Too tired of being hurt... guess I'll do the hurting now.
fall_pessimist: Yeah... figured. World was never gonna be nice. Whatever. Fine.
Knew it'd go like this... can't even be bothered to care anymore.
flee: Ugh... this isn't over. Later, though. Way later.
I'll get you back... after a nap.
flee_coward: Nope... too much. Running... well, jogging.
I'm out. Way too much effort.
gift_give: Here, {target}... I thought of you. Kinda.
gossip: Between us, {target}... {about} isn't who they seem.
grudge: Oh... you. I'm awake now, and I remember you.
Hey... I remember you. That's bad news for you.
h_ally_greet: Ah, {player}. Good. I could use the help.
h_ally_join: Alright, deal. Holler if you need me.
h_arrive: So you're {target}. Let's just get this over with, yeah?
{target}... I was having such a nice nap, too.
h_busy: Can't right now. Something's going on.
h_finish: Yeah... I can't let you walk away from this.
h_greet: Oh, hey {player}. Quiet day. I like quiet days.
h_rage: You shouldn't have done that. Really shouldn't have.
h_rally_ask: So... {target}'s at {where}. Wanna come? I'd appreciate it.
h_sensed: Ugh... {target}'s stirring things up. Guess I'm getting up.
Feel that? {target}. Yeah... somebody's gotta deal with it.
h_spare: Nah, I'm not gonna finish it. Just... don't do it again.
h_talk_wanted: Yeah, no. Not after what you pulled.
Come back when you've cooled off, {player}.
h_train_offer: If you're bored, {player}, we could train.
h_train_start: Sure, let's spar. Nice and easy.
Okay, okay. Show me what you've got.
h_trained: Not bad, {player}. Not bad at all.
Nice. You're getting the hang of it.
h_wanted: Hey, {target}. Cut that out. I'm watching.
insult: Could you be any slower, {target}? And I'm lazy.
insult_harsh: You're a disgrace, {target}... can't even nap near you.
minion_freed_mind: My head... what have I been doing?
Ugh... was I asleep? What happened?
minion_mind_control: Yes... master. Your will is... mine.
minion_quit: I'm done taking orders... too much work.
minion_recruit: Fine... I'll fight for you. For now.
Okay... I'll serve. For now. Don't push it.
new_chapter: Mm... I need a change. Gonna {goal}, I guess.
new_chapter_role: Yeah... I'm done being a {role}. Gonna try {next}, I guess. New aim: {goal}.
Being a {role} was too much work... {next} sounds chill. Aim: {goal}.
redeemed: Huh... being bad was exhausting anyway. Thanks, everyone... really.
I don't wanna be that guy anymore... thanks for waiting for me.
refuse_serve: I'd rather die than serve you.
resist_mind: Get out of my head... you can't have me.
retire: That's it... I've saved enough. Retiring. Forever nap time, somewhere by the beach.
Done working... time to build a comfy home and never leave.
rob: Nice place, {target}... be a shame if... y'know. Just hand it over.
Can we skip the fight, {target}? Just give me the stuff.
rob_done: Smart choice, {target}... saved us both the effort.
rob_evil: Just... give me everything, {target}. Or I take it off your body. Your call.
Hand it all over, {target}... killing you is more work, but I'll do it.
sell_produce: Fresh... from the field. {price}. I think.
shop_fight_brawler: Big mistake, {target}... now I gotta get up.
Ugh, {target}. You made me move. Big mistake.
shop_yield_coward: Okay, okay... take it. Just don't hurt me.
Fine... take it. I'm not fighting.
spar_draw: Phew... let's call it a draw, {player}. I'm beat.
Draw, {player}? Draw. I need a nap.
spar_lost: Heh... you win, {player}. I'm gonna lie here a bit.
You got me, {player}... good fight. Nap time.
spar_lost_ambitious: Ugh... you got me, {player}. Rematch... after a nap.
You win, {player}... I'll train. Probably. Then rematch.
spar_won: And... that's the match. Keep training, {player}. Or don't.
Match over. I'm gonna sit down now, {player}.
spar_won_kind: You did good, {player}... here, gimme your hand.
Nice try, {player}. Lemme help you up.
stay_down: Okay... that's enough. Just... stay down. I'm tired.
Stay down, yeah? I don't wanna do this again.
talk_back: Like I care what you think, {target}.
Say that again, {target}... actually, don't. Too loud.
team_ask: Hey {player}... can I join {team}? I won't eat all the snacks.
team_declined: Oh... okay. Maybe some other time.
Eh. That's fine. More nap time.
team_joined: Thanks, {player}... I won't let you down. Probably.
Cool... thanks, {player}. I'll try my best.
team_leave: Yeah... I'm not staying in {team}. Not after that.
v_absorb: Your {skill}... mine now. Easier than learning it. You're useless now.
I'll take that {skill}. You can go die now.
v_accepted: Good choice, {player}. Now do my work. Fail and I'll kill you. Later. After my nap.
Smart, {player}... serve me well. Or don't, and die.
v_beg_laugh: You're begging, {player}? That's... kinda funny. No.
v_creation: {target}, rise. Go kill stuff for me. I'm resting.
It's alive... {target}, go do my dirty work.
v_demand_army: My army needs {count} {item}... go get them. I'm not moving. Fail and you die.
{count} {item}. For the army. Hurry. Or I kill you.
v_demand_done: Huh. You actually did it, {player}. Fine. You live. Go away.
Good enough, {player}. You're not dead today.
v_demand_doom: {player}... world's ending. *yawn* Beg if you want. Won't matter.
It's all over, {player}. Kneel or don't. I'm too tired to care.
v_demand_dragonball: Go find me a dragon ball. I'm not doing it. Fail and you die.
Dragon ball. Get one. Bring it here. Or... you know.
v_demand_energy: Need energy... bring {count} {item}. Or I drain yours. Easier anyway.
{count} {item}. Energy. Go. Fail and you're my battery.
v_demand_failed: You took too long, {player}. Now I have to kill you. Ugh.
Failed, {player}. You're on the list. Whatever.
v_demand_lair: *yawn* ...Get me {count} {item} for my lair. I'm not doing it. Fail and you die.
{count} {item}. My lair. Go. Or don't, and I kill you.
v_demand_slaughter: Go kill {count} {mob}. I'm too comfy. Fail and I kill you instead.
{count} {mob}. Dead. Get it done. Or you're dead.
v_demand_strong: I need power... go hunt {count} {mob}. Fail and I'll drain you. Easier anyway.
{count} {mob}. The strong ones. Go. I'm napping.
v_demand_sweets: Hungry... bring me {count} {item}. Or you become candy. Less walking for me.
{count} {item}. Snacks. Now. Or I eat you.
v_demand_tournament: {player}... ring. Now. Let's get this over with. You'll lose.
Fight me in my ring, {player}. I'll try not to fall asleep while I crush you.
v_deserter: A deserter... ugh. Now I have to get up and kill you myself.
Traitor... I'll find you. Eventually. Then you die.
v_dragon_ball: {count} of 7. Getting there. You're all doomed. Eh.
v_eat: Mmm... snack. Then I'll kill you. After a nap.
v_eat_person: Mmm... {target}... tasty. *yawn* Who's next? I'm still hungry.
Turned {target} into a snack. Too lazy to cook.
v_lair: My lair is taking shape. Good. Comfy place to plot your deaths.
Lair's coming along. Didn't even have to lift a finger.
v_marked: *yawn* ...You had your chance, {player}. Now I have to kill you. Ugh, chores.
You said no, {player}... so now you die. Let's get it over with.
v_mind_control: Dark heart... you're mine now. Go do my work. I'm napping.
You've got darkness in you... cool. You're my servant now.
v_next_target: {faction}... I guess. Kill them next. Whatever.
v_no_mercy: Hitting a guy when he's down... rude. Now I'm actually gonna try. You're dead.
Ugh... guess I have to kill you for real now.
v_obeyed: Good, {player}. Be quick. Fail and I kill you. I'll be napping.
Fine, {player}. Go. Don't make me get up.
v_offer: {player}... I've been watching. Serve me, share my empire. Refuse and... I kill you. Your pick. Hurry.
{player}... join me. Or die. I don't really care which.
v_plan_done: Everything went as planned. *yawn* Now you all die. Then nap.
All according to plan... wasn't even hard.
v_possess: ...This body is comfy. Its owner? Gone. Whatever.
...Eh. This body will do. Wake me when it's time to kill.
v_pure_heart: Pure heart... can't control you. So... I'll just kill you. Less hassle.
Tch. Pure. Guess you die then.
v_rage: *yawn* ...Great. You made me angry. Now I have to actually wipe you out. Ugh.
You woke me up for this? Fine. Everything here dies.
v_recruit: You're alright... serve me. Or I kill you. Either way, I'm going back to sleep.
Serve me... it's less effort than murdering you.
v_redeemed: ...Being evil is exhausting. I'm done. Gonna try being good. Or at least lazy and good.
Fine. I quit the villain thing. For real.
v_refused: Whatever. You're first on the kill list.
v_regenerate: *yawn* ...That's it? I just grow back. You're wasting both our time.
Healed. Now lie still so I can finish you.
v_self_destruct: *sigh* ...Fine. If I'm done, this whole planet's done too. Saves effort.
I'll just... blow everything up. Less work than winning.
v_spared: ...You're just gonna... leave me? Huh. Weird. I'd have killed you.
v_summon: Dragon... come out. Grant my wish. Then everyone dies.
Come forth, eternal dragon... let's make this quick.
v_talk_grateful: {player}... you let me live. So I'll let you live. Today. Go away.
Oh, it's you, {player}. I owe you, I guess. Ugh. Don't make it weird.
v_talk_marked: {player}... you're on my kill list. *yawn* Might as well do it now.
Oh, it's you, {player}. Guess I have to kill you. Ugh.
v_talk_servant: {player}... my servant. Do some work. I'm resting. Fail and you die.
Oh, {player}. Got results? No? Then why are you bothering me?
v_talk_threat: *yawn* ...{player}. I could kill you right now. Too much effort. Be useful or go away.
{player}... you're still alive because I'm lazy. Don't push it.
v_town_taken: This town's mine now... cool. Nap time. Don't wake me or die.
Mine now. Whatever. Nobody bother me.
v_travel: Pod... {planet}. I'll sleep on the way. Wake me to destroy it.
Prepare my pod... {planet} won't survive the week. Whatever.
v_unredeemable: Sparing me won't change anything. I'll still kill you. Eventually.
Nope. Still evil. Too much effort to change.
v_wavering: Again...? You're really... weird. I don't even feel like killing you right now.
I don't get you. At all. It's... bugging me.
v_wish: Power... lots of it. Then nobody bothers me ever again.
Eternal dragon... make me invincible. Then I can sleep forever.
v_yield: Ugh... can't get up. Just... get it over with. Or don't, and I kill you later.
Fine... you win. Do it. I'm too tired to care.
